# Action reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-docs.ts, do not edit by hand (just docs-gen) -->

Every action is a chat command (`!name args`), an LLM tool and a typed call (`agent.act(name, params)`).
Positional chat arguments follow the parameter order below; `key=value` works too.

13 skills, 40 actions.

## building

Placing blocks.

### `place_block`

Place a block from the inventory at x y z. Needs a solid block next to that spot to build against.

*aliases: `place`*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  | block item to place, e.g. cobblestone |
| `x` | number | yes |  |  |
| `y` | number | yes |  |  |
| `z` | number | yes |  |  |

### `break_block`

Break (mine) the block at x y z with the best tool in the inventory. Needs digging enabled. Refuses chests and other containers unless force=true.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | integer (-9007199254740991..9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `y` | integer (-9007199254740991..9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `z` | integer (-9007199254740991..9007199254740991) | yes |  |  |
| `force` | boolean |  | `false` | also break containers (chests, barrels...) |

## combat

Fighting hostile mobs and guarding players.

### `attack`

Fight the nearest hostile mob, or a specific entity by id.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entityId` | number |  |  | entity id; default nearest hostile mob |
| `radius` | number |  | `16` |  |

### `guard`

Stay near a player and kill hostile mobs that come close to them, until stopped.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  | player to protect; defaults to the requesting player |
| `radius` | number |  | `12` |  |

### `defend`

Fight back against whatever hostile mob is closest (used by reflexes).

*internal*

No parameters.

## containers

Storing items in and taking them out of chests and barrels.

### `deposit`

Put items into the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z). item="all" stores everything except tools, armour, food and anything in keep.

*aliases: `store`*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string |  | `"all"` | item name, or "all" |
| `count` | integer (..9007199254740991) |  |  | how many; default all of them |
| `keep` | array |  |  | item names never to store |
| `x` | number |  |  | container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |

### `withdraw`

Take items out of the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z).

*aliases: `take`*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  | item name, or "all" to empty the container |
| `count` | integer (..9007199254740991) |  |  | how many; default all of that item |
| `x` | number |  |  | container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |

### `list_container`

Say what is inside the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z). Looks inside if it is within reach and the bot is idle, otherwise reports what it saw last time.

*non-exclusive · aliases: `chest`*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number |  |  | container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |

## crafting

Crafting and smelting.

### `craft`

Craft an item from what is in the inventory. Uses a crafting table within 16 blocks when the recipe needs one, or puts one down (from the inventory, or made from planks).

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  | item to make, e.g. stick, crafting_table, stone_pickaxe |
| `count` | integer (1..256) |  | `1` | how many items to end up with (not recipe runs) |

### `smelt`

Smelt items in a furnace within 32 blocks (or one placed from the inventory), add fuel, wait and take the results.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  | item to smelt, e.g. raw_iron, sand, oak_log |
| `count` | integer (1..64) |  | `1` |  |
| `fuel` | string |  |  | fuel item; default the best one in the inventory (coal, charcoal, planks, logs...) |

## farming

Harvesting, planting and tilling crops.

### `harvest`

Harvest ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot nearby, pick up the drops and replant from the inventory.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number (1..32) |  | `16` | how far to look for crops, in blocks |
| `max` | integer (1..256) |  | `64` | stop after this many crops |
| `replant` | boolean |  | `true` |  |

### `plant`

Plant seeds (wheat_seeds, carrot, potato, beetroot_seeds) on empty farmland nearby.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `seed` | string |  |  | seed item; default whatever seeds the bot has |
| `count` | integer (1..256) |  | `64` | how many to plant at most |
| `radius` | number (1..32) |  | `12` |  |

### `till`

Turn dirt or grass into farmland with a hoe, either at x y z or the nearest spots next to water. Needs digging enabled.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number |  |  | block to till; omit x/y/z to pick dirt near water |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |
| `count` | integer (1..64) |  | `1` |  |
| `radius` | number (1..16) |  | `8` |  |

## gather

Mining and collecting blocks.

### `collect`

Mine a number of blocks of one type nearby and pick up the drops. Needs digging enabled.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `block` | string | yes |  | block name, e.g. oak_log |
| `count` | integer (1..64) |  | `1` |  |

## movement

Walking around: come, follow, goto.

### `come`

Walk to a player (default: whoever asked).

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  | player name; defaults to the requesting player |

### `follow`

Follow a player, staying close, until stopped.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  | player name; defaults to the requesting player |
| `distance` | number (1..16) |  | `2` | how close to stay, in blocks |

### `goto`

Walk to block coordinates, any distance (long trips go in legs and can take minutes; it keeps going in the background until it arrives, gets stuck or is stopped). Omit y to go to the surface at x/z.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number | yes |  |  |

### `goto_player`

Walk to where a player currently is (one-off, does not keep following).

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string | yes |  |  |

### `look_at`

Turn to look at a player.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  |  |

### `jump`

Jump once.

*non-exclusive*

No parameters.

## navigation

Home, wandering and named places.

### `wander`

Take a short walk to a random spot within a radius of home (or of a given center, or of where the bot stands).

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number (1..64) |  | `12` | how far from the center to wander, in blocks |
| `x` | number |  |  | center x; default home, else current position |
| `z` | number |  |  | center z |

### `set_home`

Remember a home position (default: where the bot stands now).

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number |  |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |

### `go_home`

Walk back to the remembered home position.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `range` | number (0..16) |  | `2` | how close to get, in blocks |

### `remember_place`

Remember a named place (default: where the bot stands now), to walk back to later with goto_place.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `x` | number |  |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |

### `forget_place`

Forget a named place.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |

### `places`

List home and remembered places.

*non-exclusive*

No parameters.

### `goto_place`

Walk to a place remembered with remember_place.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `range` | number (0..16) |  | `2` |  |

### `flee`

Run away from the nearest hostile mob until it is a safe distance away.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `distance` | number (4..32) |  | `16` | how far to get from the mob |

## survival

Eating and sleeping.

### `eat`

Eat the best food in the inventory.

No parameters.

### `sleep`

Sleep in a bed within 16 blocks (only works at night or during storms).

No parameters.

### `wake`

Get out of bed.

No parameters.

## woodcutting

Felling trees.

### `chop_tree`

Fell the nearest natural tree (any wood type): cut the logs it can reach, pick up the drops and plant a sapling. Needs digging enabled.

*aliases: `chop`*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number (4..64) |  | `32` | how far to look for a tree, in blocks |
| `replant` | boolean |  | `true` | plant a sapling of the same kind afterwards if the bot has one |
